action.objective: Advance the e-pawn to e7, forcing promotion next move while keeping d5/c5 pawns and remaining pieces intact.
action.rationale: e6e7 is the only commit_ready move: exact +2220 at depth 4 with complete safety (no mate-in-one, tactical refutation not_found). PV e7 then e8=Q runs a second queen alongside rook a4, bishop b4, and passed pawns c5/d5. Black's lone king (h7) and pawns cannot stop promotion; h6/g5 pawns are far from the queening square.
